name: Last winter's coldest stretch (replay)
capacityNote: Hypothetical: capacity set 3 MMcf/day below this scenario's peak-day demand. Daily limit per gas day; within-day swings are covered by linepack and storage (assumed).
source: Hourly temperatures: routine hourly observations at ANCHORAGE TED STEVENS INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT (PANC), IEM ASOS archive (data/raw/asos_panc_lastwinter.csv), 2026-01-02 to 2026-01-05. Window: coldest 72 h (12:00 day 1 to 12:00 day 4) between 2025-11-01 and 2026-03-31, chosen from ACIS StnData daily max/min (data/raw/acis_panc_2025-11_2026-03.json). systemMMcfh = (a + b × ACIS daily HDD) × demand_shape, from data/system_fit.json; daily HDD 68, 72, 73, 60.

forecastRuns.label: sourced
forecastRuns.source: IEM MOS archive, PANC, NBS run 2026-01-01T07Z (data/raw/iem_mos_nbs_panc_lastwinter.json), with NBE beyond its range (data/raw/iem_mos_nbe_panc_lastwinter.json). Hourly values: the run's hourly temperatures (3-hourly tmp, 12-hourly beyond NBS), interpolated linearly; spread from tsd.
